第17章 持续爱抚
玄月MM和魔法小猫离开以后，二小姐将心中的愤怒完全暴露出来，“你这个坏蛋，欺负了我还想着跳槽，我要告诉姐姐！”
刘烨汗颜，这哪跟哪啊？自己什么时候欺负过她？有也只是正当防卫吧？
“我敬爱的二小姐，都说了，我只是开个玩笑，小的以后天天陪你玩游戏，不过……这件事情不必劳烦大小姐了，她老人家整天忙里忙外的，哪里顾得上这种事情？”刘烨陪笑着说道。
“哼，我就知道你害怕姐姐！告诉你，姐姐可是华夏大学古武社团的社长，怕了吧？看你以后还敢不敢跳槽？”小丫头得意的撇嘴说道。
华夏大学古武社团社长？我的个娘亲啊？难怪自己面对大小姐的时候会觉得心惊胆战，原来人家不仅是练家子，还是很有来头的练家子，这都什么年代了，女孩子家家不好好勾搭男朋友，练什么古武嘛？
看到刘烨眼中的恐惧，叶雨蝶十分得意，“嘿嘿，只要你以后乖乖听我的话，我就给你保密！”
闻言，刘烨撇嘴一笑，坏坏的说道：“二小姐，你是不是忽略了一件事情？屁股痒痒了吧？”
“啊！”小丫头惊呼一声，急忙向后退去，目光说不出的委屈，“二号你别过来，不要打我屁股！”
“你叫我什么？”
“六哥……”在刘烨的威逼之下，小丫头终于不甘心的屈服了。
“这就对嘛！快去跟大小姐他们汇合吧！你现在已经是隐藏职业了，刷副本的作用可是很大的！对了，千万不要把今天的事情告诉大小姐，不然你知道后果是什么……？”刘烨邪恶的笑道。
“知道了，可是我想和你一起踢场子！”
“我敬爱的大小姐啊！您就放我一马吧！因为你的事情，我连任务都耽误了！”刘烨哭丧着脸说道。
叶雨蝶见状，天真一笑，说道：“那好吧！我先去帮助姐姐他们，你去任务吧！”
送走二小姐，刘烨终于松了口气，和这样捣蛋的小恶霸在一起简直就是折磨，好在自己的心智比较坚定，幽幽的哀叹一声，捏碎回城卷轴，直接回到了落日城复活点。
落日城很大，不过刘烨有任务提示在手，迷路这种低级的错误是不会出现的，按照任务提示，很快便找到了传说中的圣殿骑士团，眼前的建筑物当真可以称得上是富丽堂皇，以假乱真……
整理一下身上的装备，雄赳赳气昂昂的向着圣殿大门走去，在这样华丽的光辉下，是一件多么神圣的事情？
正当刘烨抬头挺胸走进圣殿的时候，一阵香风迎面而来，一道黑影猛然间跟自己碰撞在一起，软绵绵的，还挺舒服呢！
“哎呦，哪里来的家伙，不长眼啊？”说话的是一位金发女子，身材高挑，天使般白净的脸蛋，握手一柄金光闪闪的长剑，一看就不是凡品，整个人看上去英气十足。

“姑娘，对不起，我不是故意的！”刘烨急忙道歉，通过观察装备，刘烨几乎可以肯定，眼前的女剑客应该是一名NPC，现阶段的玩家哪里穿得起这样华丽丽的装备，真想宰了她，看看能不能把装备爆出来？
金发女剑客愤恨的看着刘烨，身穿一身破烂，一看就是那些来自异世的冒险者，“滚出去，你们这些来自异世的穷鬼，圣殿骑士团也是你们随便进的地方吗？”
“额，这位姑娘，你不能看不起人啊！哥可是很厉害的！”刘烨不爽的叫嚷道。
“切~！本姑娘一剑就可以把你秒杀！”金发女剑客满脸鄙夷，驱赶着刘烨。
刘烨那个气愤啊？想当年哥可是跟白虎城城主称兄道弟的伟人，如今被一个小小的NPC美眉鄙视了，是可忍孰不可忍，刘烨拿出了自己的秘密武器，“你以为哥吃饱了没事啊？哥可是有任务的人，这是村长给我的介绍信，让我来这里找古德老大！”
刘烨从背包里取出介绍信，得意的晃悠着。
“你真的是来找古德老师的？”金发女剑客估疑的看着刘烨手中的介绍信，自己身为古德团长的亲传弟子，自然知道老师与新手村长的交情。
“废话，哥都好几天没吃饱了，哪里有时间浪费时间？”
“那好吧，你跟我来！”金发女剑客的态度好了许多，带着刘烨穿过迷宫一样的走廊，终于看到了一位白发苍苍的骑士NPC，正是自己的任务目标——圣殿骑士团团长古德！
“老师，这小子说是来找你的，还带着村长前辈的介绍信！”金发女剑客恭敬的站在古德身边，说道。
正在整理文件的古德团长诧异的抬起头，当他看到跟班二号以后，目光忽然间变得深邃起来，“咦，好奇特的剑客体质，你是狄龙老头派来的？”
“是的，团长前辈！”刘烨恭敬的走上前，然后将村长介绍信交给古德。
古德团长唯一有机会找到拜亚王国遗迹的冒险者，真是太好了！我们最近在埋骨地探查到一丝拜亚王国的气息，你愿意帮我去调查一下吗？”
“当然愿意，我来找您不就是为了这个吗？”刘烨爽快的答应。
系统提示：获得系统主线任务【古老王国的气息】，任务目标：前往埋骨地，探查古老拜亚王国的气息，找到气息的根源……
刘烨激动的想要咆哮出来，奈何在圣殿骑士团这种庄严的地方自己还是矜持点比较好，早就知道这个任务很牛叉，可是没想到竟然是传说中的主线任务！
要知道，传说中的系统主线任务可是能够推动历史车轮的。
“埋骨地地势险恶，生活着各种可怕的亡灵怪物，你现在的实力还有点牵强，这是我的学生尤莉，她会陪你一同前往，助你一臂之力！”古德团长介绍道。
“尤莉？”刘烨诧异的看向金发女剑客，没想到这位漂亮的NPC美女竟然叫做尤莉，而且还是自己的帮手，奶奶的，虽然有帮手是好事，但是这样霸气侧露的美女帮手还是不要的好。
“老师放心，我一定会完成任务的！”尤莉恭敬的向古德行礼，看上去对自己的老师相当尊敬。

古德团长目露沧桑，幽幽的叹息一声，说道：“我们身上都流淌着拜亚的血液，特别是你……，一定要找到我们的故土！”
“是！”
尤莉坚定的点头，然后朝着圣殿外面走去，“小子，快点跟上，希望你不要拖我的后腿！”
看着尤莉高挑的背影，那屁股一扭一扭的，心里直痒痒，奶奶的，千万不能让一个NPC比下去，自己可是顶级玩家，“哥会让你知道哥的战斗力！”
却见尤莉忽然间停下脚步，扭过头，瞥了刘烨**一眼，语气玩味的说道：“是吗？看不出来哦！咯咯……！”
“擦，哥怒了！”刘烨心里火气横冲直撞，怒气冲冲的追上去，直接搂住尤莉纤细的腰肢，敢鄙视哥的小弟弟，难道不知道哥是纵横花海的高手吗？
然而，当他搂住尤莉的时候，猛然间感觉到了不对，尤莉没有丝毫抗拒的意思，看向自己的目光充满戏谑之色，“舒服吗？”
“不错啊！”刘烨下意识的回答道。
“还有更舒服的呢！”尤莉得意的娇笑一声，系统提示在她耳边响起：受到异性侵犯，是否使用天雷惩罚？
“是！”
系统提示：请选择天雷强度，共有三种套餐供您选择，【一炮到底】直接使对方空血，死亡；【于心不忍】让对方承受天雷的痛苦，残留1%的生命值；【持续爱抚】每3秒落下一道小型雷电，减少总血量的1%，直到对方残血为止！
“那就持续爱抚吧！这个不错！”尤莉满意的做出了选择。
刘烨这边，意识到尤莉真正用意之后，急忙松开自己的胳膊，但是已经来不及了，在尤莉戏谑的目光下，自己的头顶天雷阵阵，3秒一道的雷电如影随形。
“啊……！小妞，哥你没完！”
于是乎，华夏区十大次级主城之一的落日城中，出现在了这样奇怪的一幕，一位可怜的玩家被天雷劈的死去活来，在他的身边还有一位身材火辣性感的NPC美女，笑盈盈的欣赏着。

此时的游戏论坛上，关于枫叶林第一位隐藏职业的话题已经成为今日的焦点，这位叫做蝶恋花的仙术师竟然是叶家财团的二小姐叶雨蝶，这让很多人诧异。
就连枫叶林内部也是一样，叶雨轩和叶夫人又吃惊又兴奋，本来她们并不打算指望叶雨蝶，这丫头只要少给叶家闯祸就很好了！
之前叶雨蝶击杀BOSS，成功冲进等级榜的事情已经很让他们吃惊了，可是没过多久，蝶恋花的职业竟然变成了隐藏职业，这就更让她们激动了！
“母亲、姐姐，雨蝶是不是很厉害？”小丫头在公会频道里得意的炫耀着。

“雨蝶真是太厉害了，没想到竟然得到了隐藏职业，”说到这里，叶夫人语气忽然变得沉重起来：“雨蝶，隐藏职业对我们枫叶林的意义重大，以后不能再淘气了，以后跟着雨轩练级，保持在等级榜前十！”
“啊？这么麻烦啊？”小丫头犹豫道。
大小姐叹息一声，说道：“小丫头，你不是一直想帮忙吗？只要你听话，就是对母亲最好的帮助！”
闻言，小丫头沉吟片刻，坚定的点头：“雨蝶以后要听话！”

Chapter 17 Continued caressing
After MM Xuan Yue and Magic Kitten left, the second young lady fully exposed the anger in her heart, "You are a bad guy, you bullied me and you still want to change jobs, I want to tell my sister!"
Liu Ye is ashamed, where is this? When had he ever bullied her? Is it just self-defense?
"My beloved second young lady, I told you that I was just joking. I will play games with you every day from now on, but... there is no need to bother the eldest lady with this matter. She is busy all day long, how can she take care of such things?" Liu Ye said with a smile.
"Hmph, I knew you were afraid of my sister! Let me tell you, my sister is the president of the Ancient Martial Arts Club of Hua Xia University. Are you afraid? Let's see if you dare to change jobs in the future?" The little girl said proudly.
President of the Ancient Martial Arts Society of Hua Xia University? My mother? No wonder I feel frightened when facing the eldest lady. It turns out that she is not only a practicing practitioner, but also a practicing practitioner with great background. What age is this? If girls don’t hook up with their boyfriends, why should they practice ancient martial arts?
Seeing the fear in Liu Ye's eyes, Ye Yudie was very proud, "Hey, as long as you obey me from now on, I will keep it a secret for you!"
Hearing this, Liu Ye curled his lips and smiled, and said mischievously: "Second Miss, did you overlook something? Is your butt itchy?"
"Ah!" the little girl exclaimed, and hurriedly stepped back, her eyes filled with indescribable grievance, "No. 2, don't come over here, don't spank me!"
"What did you call me?"
"Brother Six..." Under Liu Ye's coercion, the little girl finally gave in unwillingly.
"That's right! Go and join the eldest lady and the others! You are now a hidden profession, and clearing dungeons is very useful! By the way, don't tell the eldest lady what happened today, otherwise you know what the consequences will be...?" Liu Ye said with an evil smile.
"I know, but I want to play games with you!"
"My beloved eldest lady! Just let me go! Because of your affairs, I was even delayed in my mission!" Liu Ye said with a sad face.
Seeing this, Ye Yudie smiled innocently and said, "Okay then! I'll go help my sister and the others first, and you can go on the mission!"
After seeing off the second young lady, Liu Ye finally breathed a sigh of relief. Being with such a naughty little bully was simply torture. Fortunately, his mind was relatively firm. With a faint sigh, he crushed the scroll of return to the city and returned directly to the resurrection point of Sunset City.
Sunset City is very big, but Liu Ye has the mission prompts in hand. Low-level mistakes like getting lost will not happen. Following the mission prompts, he quickly found the legendary Knights Templar. The building in front of him can really be called magnificent, and it is fake and real...
Arrange your equipment and walk majestically towards the gate of the temple. How sacred is it under such gorgeous light?
Just as Liu Ye walked into the temple with his head held high, a gust of fragrant wind came towards him, and a black shadow suddenly collided with him. It was soft and quite comfortable!
"Hey, where does this guy come from, doesn't he have eyes?" The speaker was a blond woman with a tall figure and an angelic fair face. She held a shining golden sword in her hand. She looked like an ordinary person at first glance, and she looked very heroic.
"Girl, I'm sorry, I didn't mean to do it!" Liu Ye apologized hastily. By observing the equipment, Liu Ye was almost certain that the female swordsman in front of him should be an NPC. How can any player at this stage afford such gorgeous equipment? I really want to kill her and see if I can explode the equipment?
The blonde female swordsman looked at Liu Ye angrily. He was dressed in rags and looked like adventurers from another world. "Get out, you poor ghosts from another world. Are the Knights Templar a place you can just enter?"
"Well, this girl, you can't look down on me! Brother, you can't look down on me!It is very powerful! Liu Ye shouted unhappily.
"Tch~! This girl can kill you instantly with one sword strike! "The blonde female swordsman drove Liu Ye away with disdain on her face.
Is Liu Ye angry? I thought back then that I was a great man who was a brother to the Lord of White Tiger City, but now he is despised by a little NPC beauty. This is unbearable. Liu Ye took out his secret weapon, "Do you think it will be okay if I am full? Brother is a person with a mission. This is the letter of introduction given to me by the village chief, asking me to come here to find Boss Gude! "
Liu Ye took out the letter of introduction from his backpack and waved it proudly.
"Are you really here to see Teacher Gude? "The blonde female swordsman looked at the letter of introduction in Liu Ye's hand suspiciously. As a direct disciple of Captain Gude, she naturally knew about the relationship between the teacher and the novice village chief.
"Nonsense, I haven't eaten enough for several days, how can I waste time? "
"Okay then, come with me! "The blonde female swordsman's attitude improved a lot, and she led Liu Ye through the maze-like corridor, and finally saw a white-haired knight NPC, who was exactly the target of her mission—Gude, the leader of the Knights Templar!
"Teacher, this guy said he came to see you, and he brought a letter of introduction from the village chief! "The blonde female swordsman stood respectfully next to Goode and said.
Captain Gude, who was sorting out documents, raised his head in surprise. When he saw Follower No. 2, his eyes suddenly became profound, "Hey, you have a strange swordsman physique. Are you sent here by Old Man Di Long? "
"Yes, senior leader! "Liu Ye stepped forward respectfully, and then handed the village chief's letter of introduction to Goode.
Captain Good is the only adventurer who has a chance to find the ruins of the Kingdom of Baia. How great! We recently detected a trace of the Kingdom of Baia in the Boneyard. Are you willing to help me investigate? "
"Of course I do. Isn't that why I came to you?" Liu Ye readily agreed.
System prompt: Obtain the main mission of the system [Breathe of the Ancient Kingdom]. Mission goal: Go to the bone burial ground, explore the breath of the ancient Kingdom of Baia, and find the source of the breath...
Liu Ye was so excited that he wanted to roar, but in a solemn place like the Knights Templar, it was better for him to be more reserved. He had long known that this mission was awesome, but he didn't expect it to be the legendary main mission!
You know, the legendary main line mission of the system can push the wheel of history.
"The terrain of the bone burial ground is dangerous, and there are all kinds of terrible undead monsters living there. Your current strength is still a bit far-fetched. This is my student Yuli. She will accompany you to help you!" Captain Good introduced.
"Yuli?" Liu Ye looked at the blonde female swordsman in surprise. Unexpectedly, this beautiful NPC beauty was actually called Yuli, and she was also his helper, grandma's. Although it was a good thing to have a helper, it was better not to have such a domineering and beautiful helper.
"Teacher, don't worry, I will definitely complete the task!" Yuli saluted to Goode respectfully, looking very respectful to her teacher.
Captain Gude's eyes showed the vicissitudes of life, and he sighed quietly and said: "We all have the blood of Baia flowing in our bodies, especially you..., we must find our homeland!"
"Yes!"
Yuli nodded firmly, and then walked towards the outside of the temple, "Boy, hurry up and follow me. I hope you won't hold me back!"
Looking at Yuli's tall back and her buttocks twisting and turning, I felt itchy in my heart. Damn it, I must not let an NPC compete with me. I am a top player. "Brother will let you know my fighting power!"
But Yuli suddenly stopped, turned her head, glanced at Liu Ye**, and said in a playful tone: "Really? You can't tell! Geez...!"
"Oh no, I'm angry!" Liu Ye was furious. He chased after you angrily and hugged Yuli's slender waist. How dare he despise his little brother?Didn’t you know that I am a master of the sea of ​​flowers?
However, when he hugged Yuli, he suddenly felt something was wrong. Yuli had no intention of resisting at all, and looked at him with a playful look, "Are you comfortable?"
"Not bad!" Liu Ye replied subconsciously.
"There are more comfortable ones!" Yuli smiled proudly, and the system prompts rang in her ears: If someone of the opposite sex is violated, should I use thunder to punish her?
"Yes!"
System prompts: Please select the intensity of the sky thunder. There are three packages for you to choose from. [One shot to the end] directly drains the opponent's blood and dies; [Unbearable] makes the opponent bear the pain of the sky thunder, leaving 1% of his health; [Continuous Caress] drops a small thunder and lightning every 3 seconds, reducing 1% of the total health until the opponent's health is left!
"Then keep caressing! This is good!" Yuli made her choice with satisfaction.
On Liu Ye's side, after realizing Yuli's true intention, he hurriedly let go of his arm, but it was too late. Under Yuli's teasing gaze, thunder bursts appeared above his head, and thunder and lightning followed him like a shadow every three seconds.
"Ah...! Little girl, you're not done yet!"
Ever since, a strange scene appeared in Sunset City, one of the top ten secondary main cities in the Huaxia Region. A poor player was struck by lightning to death, and beside him there was a hot and sexy NPC beauty, smiling and admiring.

At this time, on the game forum, the topic about the first hidden profession in Maple Leaf Forest has become the focus today. This fairy magician named Die Lianhua turned out to be Ye Yudie, the second lady of the Ye Family Consortium, which surprised many people.
Even inside Maple Leaf Forest, it was the same. Ye Yuxuan and Mrs. Ye were surprised and excited. Originally, they had not planned to count on Ye Yudie. It would be great if this girl would cause less trouble for the Ye family!
They were already surprised when Ye Yudie killed the BOSS and successfully entered the level list, but not long after, Die Lianhua's profession turned into a hidden profession, which made them even more excited!
"Mom, sister, isn't Yudie very powerful?" the little girl showed off proudly in the guild channel.
"Yudie is so awesome. I didn't expect to get the hidden profession." At this point, Mrs. Ye's tone suddenly became serious: "Yudie, the hidden profession is of great significance to our Maple Leaf Forest. I can't be naughty anymore. I will level up with Yuxuan in the future and stay in the top ten of the level list!"
"Ah? Is it so troublesome?" the little girl hesitated.
The eldest lady sighed and said, "Little girl, haven't you always wanted to help? As long as you are obedient, you are the best help to my mother!"
Hearing this, the little girl pondered for a moment and nodded firmly: "Yudie must be obedient from now on!"
